data.action: 单手抓车厢扶手探出身躯迎风狂驰，霓虹光芒倒退飞掠，发丝狂乱飞扬
data.camera: side view, dynamic angle, high speed motion blur background
data.description: 【露西 · 磁悬浮空轨的车厢迎风】在夜之城摩天大楼之间飞速穿梭的高空磁悬浮列车外廊间，呼啸的狂风撕扯着衣摆。露西单手拉着车厢扶手，身体探向车外俯瞰脚下的霓虹车流。高速掠过的全息广告光带将她白皙的面孔染上绚烂光芒，渐变短发在狂暴气流中狂舞，展现出狂野而自由的街头灵魂。
data.lighting: 高速倒退的五彩霓虹广告牌形成长曝光拖尾动态光效
data.location: 高空穿梭磁浮列车敞开式连接处
data.promptProse: Lucy grips the monorail carriage handrail and leans toward the Night City traffic below, her charcoal sleeveless tank, cargo joggers and neon straps pulled by the train's rush. The dynamic side view leaves nearby carriage metal sharp while billboards trail behind in motion. Passing multicolored advertisements sweep across her rainbow hair and face, forming extended colored reflections along the rail above the deeper city streets.
data.title: 露西 · 磁悬浮空轨的车厢迎风
